description: This file contains implementation of a report named 'sales_order_trends' for the ERPNext system. It defines an execute function that retrieves sales order data based on provided filters, processes the data to generate chart-compatible data, and produces the report columns, data, and chart configuration.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main function invoked to generate the sales order trends report. It fetches data, computes conditions, and prepares chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data(data, conditions, filters)
methods.description: Helper function to process raw data into chart-friendly format, aggregating datapoints over columns.
